## Raw Strings

```r
r"(raw string)"
R"{another raw string}"
R"--[yet another ]- raw string]--"

r"(")"
r"("")"
r"(')"
r"('')"

r"-(-)-"
r"-()-)-"
r"--()-")--"

r"( () )"
r"(())"
r"( ())"
r"(() )"
r"-())-"
r"-(())-)-"

r"(raw
string
)"

# Empty strings with no `string_content` node
r"()"
r'()'
R"{}"
r"--[]--"

# Leading whitespace and newlines after open
r"(  hello)"
r"(\nhello)"
r"(
hello
)"
f(r"(\nhello\n)")
f(r"(
hello
)")

# Single quoted raw strings
r'(a)'
r'(')'
r'(")'

r()
```
